family: All Boolean sign truth tables in dimensions 0 through 3; point defects in dimensions 2 through 8; dictator sanity check
parameter_domain: n in {0,1,2,3}; point defects n in {2,...,8}; rational damping r=exp(-2t) in {1/4,1/2,3/4,1}
case_count: 278 exhaustive truth tables plus 7 point-defect truth tables; 4 damping values per spectrum
symmetry_reduction: None; all truth tables explicitly included
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transforms and Fraction probabilities, influences, and polynomial weights. Logarithms are retained as formal log(1/p) atoms; no floating logarithm certifies an inequality. All-parameter inequalities are proved analytically in DERIVATION.md.
memory_estimate: Less than 30 MB; largest truth table 256 entries
proof_role: Finite checks validate algebra and conventions; they do not prove the universal integrated influence target
